prompt:
Generate one high-quality cinematic 16:9 image for the specified section, not a generic slide or dashboard. No letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, arrows, diagrams, interface, checkmarks, traffic-light statuses or readable documents. The compositor adds every semantic mark independently. Do not invent a completed publication, a live security test, a solved outing, approval or consensus. Fictional editorial staging, not documentary evidence. Rich material detail, carefully controlled light, credible objects and hands. Keep designated annotation zones visually quiet. Never fill quiet zones with invented panels. Reference images establish cast and room identity only; follow this section's camera and blocking.
VISUAL FORMAT: new-fact-correspondence
TEACHING PURPOSE: Give the new venue reply a source and update only its narrow implication.
CAMERA: Close-up correspondence arriving into the decision field.
An open plain ochre envelope and a large blank ivory note entering from the RIGHT edge of a dark blue planning desk, lit by a sharp afternoon shaft. A softly defocused empty community-room doorway in far background. Note occupies RIGHT HALF; LEFT HALF is clear dark tabletop for a source label and the eliminated alternative. No text, clock, calendar, date, digits, arrows or seals. This is an illustrative incoming venue response, not a real message or exhaustive search.
COMPOSITING INTENT: A source-stamped venue note occupies the right; the single ruled-out option sits on the left. Unchanged constraints remain as a narrow baseline.
SEMANTIC AUTHORITY FOR CONTEXT ONLY, NEVER RENDER THESE WORDS: NEW FACT / FICTIONAL VENUE REPLY. Now the new fact arrives. In this authored variant, the venue replies: no alternative time is available for this room that day. What changes? Moving within that room and day drops out. The travel conflict, other members' plans, and the limit on booking changes remain.
